V2 is retained only as a historical design reference. New and regenerated pages use V3.

The V2 renderer was configured through an optional YAML-like block at the top of a source essay:

---
subtitle: A bespoke hero line
featured_labels:
  1987-1990: The origin signal
era_gradients:
  1987-1990: "#35105c,#0b1726"
---

Keys in nested maps correspond to the text before the first colon in a section heading.
